pages.text: The monstrous wolf, son of Loki, on the isle of Lyngvi. His bite withers, and a free Fenrir heals his wounds fast and calls wargs.
Bind him with Gleipnir (use it on the wolf): for 8 seconds he cannot bite, barely moves and takes half again as much damage. Then the fetter snaps.
While the wolf is free, the weapons of men barely wound him: every blow does only a quarter of its damage. Without Gleipnir he cannot be beaten - buy the fetter from the dwarf.
